scripts.dev: concurrently -k "PORT=3001 node be/server/server.js" "until curl --fail --silent http://127.0.0.1:3001/health >/dev/null; do sleep 2; done; vite dev --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3000"
scripts.build: node scripts/gen-theme.mjs && vite build && node scripts/mark-build-esm.mjs
scripts.lint: eslint be/server fe/static tests fe/src scripts eslint.config.mjs vite.config.mjs be/server/services/arrivalAlert.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "be/server/**/*.js" "fe/static/**/*.{js,html,css}" "fe/src/**/*.{js,mjs,ts,svelte,css,html}" "tests/**/*.{js,mjs,ts}" "scripts/**/*.mjs" package.json pnpm-lock.yaml pnpm-workspace.yaml README.md AGENTS.md .github/workflows/ci.yml eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json vite.config.mjs tsconfig.json be/server/services/arrivalAlert.mjs be/server/services/arrivalAlert.d.mts
scripts.verify: pnpm run check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm test && pnpm run build
